usedFor: Chargebee holds subscriptions and billing, and Freshsales Classic holds the deal that “Update Deal” keeps in step.

bestTemplate.name: “Subscription Is Cancelled” in Chargebee, then “Update Deal” in Freshsales Classic
bestTemplate.why: A cancellation changes what the deal is worth, so its stage and amount can follow it.

watchOut: “Update Deal” finds the deal by ID or name, so the billing event must carry one that matches.
